issues.description: Iteration cap of 100 may prevent convergence of the fixed-point iteration, producing incorrect F values and wrong answers.
Algorithm has high worst-case time complexity (per-vertex knapsack up to capacity ~5000). Even with reduced iterations it can still TLE on worst-case inputs.
No test suite or test cases were provided to validate correctness and performance.
Solution relies on many names preloaded by the evaluation environment; this increases coupling to that environment.
